basics.name: Mayank Singh Rathore
basics.headline: Senior DevOps Engineer | Cloud Architect | AI/ML Enthusiast
basics.summary: Cloud-native DevOps engineer with 7+ years architecting highly available systems on AWS and Azure. Expert in Kubernetes orchestration, IaC automation, and GitOps workflows. Proven track record of migrating legacy infrastructure to cloud, containerizing 30+ mission-critical applications, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines for scale. Passionate about leveraging AI/ML and GenAI to enhance operational intelligence.
